user.title: Energy Planner
user.description: Name this planner, then open Configure to map energy, climate, EV and Enphase inputs. Create one named planner per EV when managing multiple vehicles.

data_description.instance_name: Unique name for this planner and its EV, for example Energy Planner - Commuter EV.

init.title: Energy Planner settings
init.description: Configure each area in one place. Expand only the sections you need; connected inputs and planner policy are saved together.

energy_inputs.name: Energy, battery, grid, and data
energy_inputs.description: Configure tariffs, forecasts, household load, battery and grid limits, and data-health thresholds.

data.ev_soc_per_kwh: Bootstrap EV SOC gained per kWh
data.ev_keep_charger_on: Keep charger enabled after target SOC

data_description.amber_import_price_entity: Sensor that exposes current and forecast grid import prices in $/kWh, AUD/kWh, or c/kWh.
data_description.amber_export_price_entity: Sensor that exposes current and forecast feed-in prices in $/kWh, AUD/kWh, or c/kWh.
data_description.pv_forecast_entity: Primary PV forecast sensor. For Solcast, select Forecast Today, not Peak Forecast Today; Energy Planner reads its detailedForecast values.
data_description.pv_forecast_secondary_entity: Optional continuation forecast. For Solcast, select Forecast Tomorrow; Energy Planner stitches its timezone-aware timestamped values after Forecast Today.
data_description.household_load_entity: Measured whole-home power sensor in W, kW, or MW. Energy Planner learns a local load forecast from Recorder history and excludes known EV charging and measured HVAC power where possible.
data_description.carbon_intensity_forecast_entity: Optional sensor that exposes current and forecast grid carbon intensity in gCO₂/kWh or kgCO₂/kWh.
data_description.pv_observed_entity: Optional actual PV power sensor used to validate and calibrate forecasts. This must be a measured power sensor, not the forecast sensor.
data_description.battery_soc_entity: Battery state-of-charge sensor that exposes a percentage value.
data_description.battery_min_soc_percent: Minimum home battery state of charge the planner tries to preserve.
data_description.battery_usable_capacity_kwh: Usable home battery capacity available for planning decisions.
data_description.battery_round_trip_efficiency_percent: Estimated battery round-trip efficiency used when valuing stored solar or tariff arbitrage.
data_description.battery_max_charge_kw: Maximum battery charge power used when estimating whether surplus solar can be absorbed.
data_description.battery_max_discharge_kw: Maximum battery discharge power used when estimating whether stored energy can serve load or export.
data_description.ev_charge_rate_kw: Assumed EV charging power used for schedule projections.
data_description.ev_soc_per_kwh: Conservative bootstrap estimate used until Recorder has enough completed charging history to learn the vehicle-specific percentage gained per kWh.
data_description.ev_continuous_charging: Choose the best continuous window to reduce charger cycling. Disable to select individual least-cost intervals.
data_description.ev_earliest_start: Local HH:MM time before which scheduled charging will not start, or None for no restriction.
data_description.ev_price_limit_enabled: Exclude charging intervals above the maximum import price.
data_description.ev_max_import_price: Highest grid import price allowed for normal scheduled charging.
data_description.ev_low_price_charging_enabled: Start opportunistic charging when the current price is at or below the configured threshold and the EV still needs charge, even before the configured earliest charging time.
data_description.ev_low_price_threshold: Import price that triggers immediate opportunistic charging, including outside the configured charging hours.
data_description.ev_daylight_lowest_cost_charging_enabled: Select the lowest effective-cost slots in a complete sunrise-to-sunset forecast. If daylight cannot meet the vehicle target, charging falls back to the ready-by schedule.
data_description.ev_keep_charger_on: Keep the charger enabled after the EV reaches target SOC so vehicle preconditioning can use grid power. Enable only when the vehicle enforces its own target SOC.
data_description.ev_confirmation_timeout_seconds: Seconds to wait for the mapped charging-state entity to confirm each start or stop command. Set to 0 for an immediate check.
data_description.ev_confirmation_retries: Additional bounded command attempts when charging feedback does not confirm the requested state.
data_description.grid_import_limit_kw: Maximum grid import power allowed in planned actions.
data_description.grid_export_limit_kw: Maximum grid export power allowed in planned actions.
data_description.bypass_safety_gates: Waives the 90% household-load coverage threshold and all production preflight requirements so Automatic control can arm. This reduces protection against unsafe inputs and unexpected demand; leave it off unless you accept that risk.
data_description.price_freshness_minutes: Maximum age for price inputs before they are treated as stale.
data_description.forecast_freshness_minutes: Maximum age for forecast inputs before they are treated as stale.
data_description.household_load_outage_grace_minutes: Minutes that a current, quality-approved built-in load model may cover an unknown or unavailable live household-load sensor.
data_description.material_change_threshold_percent: Minimum plan-change percentage before a new plan is considered materially different.
data_description.minimum_tariff_confidence: Lowest tariff confidence allowed before tariff-driven decisions should be treated as degraded.
data_description.minimum_solar_confidence: Lowest solar forecast confidence allowed before solar-driven decisions should be treated as degraded.
data_description.minimum_load_confidence: Lowest load forecast confidence allowed before load-driven decisions should be treated as degraded.
data_description.minimum_climate_confidence: Lowest climate confidence allowed before climate decisions should be treated as degraded.
data_description.minimum_ev_confidence: Lowest EV confidence allowed before EV charging decisions should be treated as degraded.
data_description.minimum_enphase_confidence: Lowest Enphase confidence allowed before battery profile decisions should be treated as degraded.

climate_inputs.name: Climate and presence
climate_inputs.description: Configure climate inputs, presence, comfort, and HVAC policy.

data_description.daikin_climate_entity: Climate entity the planner may control after active mode is enabled.
data_description.daikin_power_entity: Optional power sensor used for HVAC thermal-model learning.
data_description.weather_entity: Optional weather entity used for outdoor temperature forecasts. For Bureau of Meteorology, select the Hourly weather entity for climate planning because Energy Planner uses near-term temperature forecast points.
data_description.climate_automation_entities: Automation entities to pause during planner HVAC control.
data_description.climate_change_from_scheduler_entity: Optional input_boolean that marks scheduler-owned climate changes.
data_description.climate_scheduler_guard_timer_entity: Select the timer paired with Scheduler Change Helper. Energy Planner keeps it active while applying climate changes so the manual-change classifier ignores planner control. Configure both fields or leave both empty.
data_description.climate_manual_override_entity: Input_boolean that immediately releases and blocks planner HVAC control. An on state is automatically cleared after the configured manual override duration.
data_description.climate_zone_entities: Zone switches or helpers are enabled and restored; zone climate entities receive the main thermostat target temperature only when zone temperature synchronisation is enabled.
data_description.climate_target_low_entity: Input number containing the occupied low comfort target.
data_description.climate_target_high_entity: Input number containing the occupied high comfort target.
data_description.person_entities: Person entities used to infer occupied or away state.
data_description.occupied_temperature_tolerance_percent: Allowed comfort-band widening while the home is occupied.
data_description.hvac_suppression_min_price_delta: Minimum price difference before the planner suppresses HVAC usage.
data_description.hvac_precondition_lead_minutes: How far ahead HVAC may precondition before an expensive or comfort-sensitive period.
data_description.hvac_precondition_min_price_delta: Minimum price difference required before HVAC preconditioning is considered worthwhile.
data_description.hvac_precondition_configured_zones_only: After applying and confirming each tariff preconditioning and coast target on the main Daikin thermostat, apply the same target to configured zone climate entities. Leave disabled to keep zone climate targets unchanged while still controlling zone switches or helpers.
data_description.hvac_precondition_while_away: Allow tariff-driven preconditioning while every configured person is away. Leave off to retain the conservative occupied-only policy.
data_description.hvac_min_cycle_minutes: Minimum time between planner HVAC mode changes.
data_description.manual_hvac_override_minutes: How long manual HVAC changes block planner-owned HVAC control.

enphase_inputs.name: Enphase
enphase_inputs.description: Configure Enphase profile monitoring, control, and policy.

data_description.enphase_profile_entity: Select entity used to read and change the current Enphase system profile.
data_description.enphase_ai_profile: Profile name to restore when planner ownership ends, normally AI Optimisation.
data_description.enphase_self_consumption_profile: Profile name used when the planner wants the battery to serve local load or export, normally Self-Consumption.
data_description.enphase_full_backup_profile: Profile name used when the planner wants to charge or preserve the battery, normally Full Backup.
data_description.enphase_profile_min_hold_minutes: Minimum time to keep an Enphase profile before changing it again.
data_description.enphase_minimum_savings: Minimum estimated daily savings required before the planner takes Enphase profile ownership.

ai_inputs.name: Safety and troubleshooting
ai_inputs.description: Configure the optional AI troubleshooting provider and production-control safeguards.

data_description.ai_task_entity: Select an AI Task entity for on-demand plan explanation and troubleshooting. Energy Planner accepts only complete actions tied to current planner evidence.
data_description.planner_enabled: Turns on planner-owned device control. Leave off until preflight and dry-run behavior are reviewed.
data_description.dry_run: When enabled, the planner records decisions without calling device-control services.
data_description.plan_fallback_notifications_enabled: Shows persistent notifications only for problems that normally require user action, such as broken required mappings or a configured grid hard limit. Routine changes and successful recovery do not notify.
data_description.ev_control_enabled: Allows active-mode EV start, stop, and schedule commands after production is armed.
data_description.climate_control_enabled: Allows active-mode climate commands after production is armed.
data_description.enphase_control_enabled: Allows active-mode Enphase profile changes after production is armed.
data_description.ai_timeout_seconds: Maximum time to wait after pressing Explain.
data_description.command_rate_limit_seconds: Cooldown between repeated commands to the same device target.
data_description.max_daily_ev_actions: Maximum EV control attempts allowed in a rolling 24-hour window. Set to 0 for no cap.
data_description.max_daily_climate_actions: Maximum climate control attempts allowed in a rolling 24-hour window. Set to 0 for no cap.
data_description.max_daily_enphase_actions: Maximum Enphase profile control attempts allowed in a rolling 24-hour window. Set to 0 for no cap.

ev_inputs.name: EV charging
ev_inputs.description: Configure EV inputs, charger controls, ready-by time, opportunistic and lowest-cost daylight charging, and charging policy.

data.ev_soc_per_kwh: Bootstrap EV SOC gained per kWh
data.ev_keep_charger_on: Keep charger enabled after target SOC

data_description.ev_soc_entity: Required EV state-of-charge sensor used for planning and automatic charge-rate calibration.
data_description.ev_charging_entity: Required entity that reports whether the EV is actively charging and identifies completed calibration sessions.
data_description.ev_connected_entity: Optional entity that reports whether the EV is plugged in.
data_description.ev_smart_charging_target_soc_entity: Required vehicle target-SOC entity. Its live percentage is the authoritative charging target.
data_description.ev_charger_entity: Switch or input boolean that directly enables and disables the charger.
data_description.ev_charger_start_entity: Optional separate switch or button used to start charging.
data_description.ev_charger_stop_entity: Optional separate switch or button used to stop charging.
data_description.battery_min_soc_percent: Minimum home battery state of charge the planner tries to preserve.
data_description.battery_usable_capacity_kwh: Usable home battery capacity available for planning decisions.
data_description.battery_round_trip_efficiency_percent: Estimated battery round-trip efficiency used when valuing stored solar or tariff arbitrage.
data_description.battery_max_charge_kw: Maximum battery charge power used when estimating whether surplus solar can be absorbed.
data_description.battery_max_discharge_kw: Maximum battery discharge power used when estimating whether stored energy can serve load or export.
data_description.ev_charge_rate_kw: Assumed EV charging power used for schedule projections.
data_description.ev_soc_per_kwh: Conservative bootstrap estimate used until Recorder has enough completed charging history to learn the vehicle-specific percentage gained per kWh.
data_description.ev_continuous_charging: Choose the best continuous window to reduce charger cycling. Disable to select individual least-cost intervals.
data_description.ev_earliest_start: Local HH:MM time before which scheduled charging will not start, or None for no restriction.
data_description.ev_price_limit_enabled: Exclude charging intervals above the maximum import price.
data_description.ev_max_import_price: Highest grid import price allowed for normal scheduled charging.
data_description.ev_low_price_charging_enabled: Start opportunistic charging when the current price is at or below the configured threshold and the EV still needs charge, even before the configured earliest charging time.
data_description.ev_low_price_threshold: Import price that triggers immediate opportunistic charging, including outside the configured charging hours.
data_description.ev_daylight_lowest_cost_charging_enabled: Select the lowest effective-cost slots in a complete sunrise-to-sunset forecast. If daylight cannot meet the vehicle target, charging falls back to the ready-by schedule.
data_description.ev_keep_charger_on: Keep the charger enabled after the EV reaches target SOC so vehicle preconditioning can use grid power. Enable only when the vehicle enforces its own target SOC.
data_description.ev_confirmation_timeout_seconds: Seconds to wait for the mapped charging-state entity to confirm each start or stop command. Set to 0 for an immediate check.
data_description.ev_confirmation_retries: Additional bounded command attempts when charging feedback does not confirm the requested state.
data_description.grid_import_limit_kw: Maximum grid import power allowed in planned actions.
data_description.grid_export_limit_kw: Maximum grid export power allowed in planned actions.
data_description.planning_horizon_hours: How many hours ahead each planning run evaluates. Twelve hours is recommended for Amber forecasts; at least 12 continuous hours is healthy, 8 to under 12 is degraded, and under 8 is unsafe.
data_description.planning_interval_minutes: Size of each planning slot in minutes. Smaller intervals give finer control but create more forecast slots.
data_description.default_ready_by: Local completion time exposed by the native EV Ready by entity.

priorities.name: Planning and priorities
priorities.description: Configure the planning window and objective order.

data_description.planning_priority_1: Highest-priority objective used when comparing otherwise valid plans.
data_description.planning_priority_2: Second objective used when the first objective does not decide the plan.
data_description.planning_priority_3: Third objective used as a tie-breaker.
data_description.planning_priority_4: Fourth objective used as a tie-breaker.
data_description.planning_priority_5: Fifth objective used as a tie-breaker.
data_description.planning_priority_6: Lowest-priority objective used last when comparing plans.
data_description.planning_horizon_hours: How many hours ahead each planning run evaluates. Twelve hours is recommended for Amber forecasts; at least 12 continuous hours is healthy, 8 to under 12 is degraded, and under 8 is unsafe.
data_description.planning_interval_minutes: Size of each planning slot in minutes. Smaller intervals give finer control but create more forecast slots.
data_description.default_ready_by: Local completion time exposed by the native EV Ready by entity.

error.invalid_ready_by: Default ready-by must be a valid local time.
error.invalid_priority_weights: Each planning priority must use a different objective.
error.invalid_load_outage_grace: Household-load outage grace must be between 0 and 30 minutes.
error.climate_scheduler_guard_pair_required: Configure both the Scheduler Change Helper and Scheduler Guard Timer, or leave both empty.
error.zone_only_preconditioning_requires_clima: Synchronise configured zone temperatures requires at least one climate entity under Climate Zones.
